planets.name: TOI-1268 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1268 with a 8.16-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1268 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1268. Its orbit and size follow Šubjak et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
